No new commands or error codes; package version remains 1.0.0 and lock counts remain commands 191, webai_ 40, research_ 121, wah_ 8, errors 39.

consumer-contract-1.5.0 (2026-05-15): chatgpt-codex placeholder tools are now live for the hard-allowlisted LT-0I/CN- Codex environment only; submit-task requires confirmed=true; get-diff may return code diff_text and never clicks Create PR. Webai count remains 37.

consumer-contract-1.5.0 (2026-05-15): Stream #5 reconciliation confirms 13 pre-existing webai tools → 35 total (22 new: 11 main-server + 11 sub-MCP), 3 new error codes (SENSITIVE_CONTENT_GUARD, SUBMCP_QUOTA_EXHAUSTED, SUBMCP_NOT_PROVISIONED), and model/control parameter updates on existing tools. No phantom tool was added. Sub-MCP modules: claude-design (4 tools, live), gemini-music (3 tools, live), chatgpt-codex (4 tools, placeholder pending sandbox provisioning).

Stream #5 Pulse integration (same contract version): adds webai_chatgpt_pulse_get and webai_chatgpt_pulse_onboard, increasing webai tools from 35 to 37 without changing contract_version or package_version; error code count remains 32.

Issue #12 (same contract version consumer-contract-1.5.0): webai_chatgpt_generate_file / webai_claude_generate_file / webai_chatgpt_canvas_export capture native downloadable DOCX (.docx) via the #10-R8/R9 pointer-follow path with an OOXML-package on-disk verifier (PK\x03\x04 + central directory + [Content_Types].xml + word/ part). .docx validated end-to-end.

Issue #12 R2 (same contract version consumer-contract-1.5.0): webai_chatgpt_generate_file / webai_claude_generate_file reject expected_extension in {pptx,xlsx} pre-flight with INVALID_ARGS — the driven ChatGPT-web/Claude-web generate-file path does not reliably emit native downloadable .pptx/.xlsx (ChatGPT renders an image; Claude returns DOCX). Doc-driven: ChatGPT help center documents no driven downloadable pptx/xlsx generate-file affordance; Claude's is doc-claimed but live-unverified. Supported expected_extension on this path: docx plus code/text (py, md, csv, svg, html, mmd, pdf). No new tool, error code, output field, or arg; reuses INVALID_ARGS from the locked 32-code taxonomy; contract_version and package_version unchanged; locks 180/32/37/121 unchanged.

Issue #16 R1 (same contract version consumer-contract-1.6.0): the #12 R2 pptx-rejection is REVERTED for webai_chatgpt_generate_file after a live probe (chatgpt-9223, 2026-05-21) confirmed ChatGPT web reliably produces a real downloadable .pptx file when the prompt explicitly requests one. The post-revamp file-card UI renders the artifact with an unnamed first icon button in the file-card header row whose click triggers GET backend-api/conversation/<id>/interpreter/download (JSON pointer hop-1) and GET backend-api/estuary/content (HTTP 200 application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.presentation, hop-2) and a real Browser.downloadWillBegin with the suggestedFilename — same shape as the #12 R1 docx path. CHATGPT_GENERATE_FILE_BUTTON_SELECTOR remapped from dead 'button.behavior-btn' to a structural anchor on the file-card header first-of-type button; src/browser/artifactClick.ts:349 OOXML-format trigger regex widened to also accept this new pattern. UNSUPPORTED_GENERATE_FILE_EXTS narrowed from {pptx,xlsx} to {xlsx} (xlsx remains rejected until independently probed). Supported expected_extension on this path: docx, pptx plus code/text (py, md, csv, svg, html, mmd, pdf). Additionally R1 fixes 3 selector drifts: Claude image-upload chip data-testid anchor (transient skeleton vs finalized filename-keyed wrapper), Gemini Veo activation (Material mdc-icon-button actionability requires force:true; menuitemcheckbox role; Deselect Videos pill rename), and Gemini Music activation (More-tools submenu removed — Music promoted to first-level menuitem; Deselect Music pill rename; Describe-your-track composer discriminator). No new tool, error code, output field, or arg; reuses INVALID_ARGS/COMMAND_TIMEOUT/ELEMENT_NOT_FOUND from the locked 32-code taxonomy; contract_version and package_version unchanged; locks 181/32/38/121 unchanged.
